name: typescript-code-graph
description: TypeScript Code Graph CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `graph` and `rewrite` domains: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the TypeScriptCodeGraphService proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest. Mirrors the go-code-graph manifest shape — same proto service surface, different language target.
